project_title: Pulse Fitness Staff Portal - Crash Pack Wizard & Printable Manager Report
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CALM REASSURING TACTICAL
context_type: mobile_web_app (employee self-service wizard) + desktop admin report view

theme_strategy.palette_notes: Light mode uses slate-50/white surfaces with generous padding and cyan/ink contrast. Dark mode uses Obsidian #0A0A0A canvas with #121212 cards and cyan highlights. NEVER use forbidden purple (#7351B7) or teal (#1B93A4). Genuinely shock-reassuring interface.

typography.heading_font: Proxima Nova, Maax Rounded, Satoshi, sans-serif
shock_friendly_typography_rules: Headings must be clear, calm, and highly legible with high contrast.
Step titles should use action-oriented simple language e.g. 'Are you safe?', 'Your details', 'The accident'.
Use minimum text-base (16px) for input text to avoid auto-zoom on mobile safari.
Large numbers and phone links must be formatted with distinct font-mono or heavy weight for 1-tap dialing.

interaction_patterns.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height for all buttons, inputs, and toggles to support stress-affected one-handed roadside usage.
interaction_patterns.yes_no_toggle: Large segment pill selector: 'YES' (accent state) vs 'NO' (neutral state) with distinct background and min-h-[52px].
interaction_patterns.photo_tile: Big dashed dropzone/camera button (min 120px tall) with direct input capture='camera' or file picker, instant thumbnail display with remove button and progress indicator.
interaction_patterns.autosave: Instant local state & API draft sync after every step change or input blur. Show reassuring 'Draft saved' chip in wizard top header.
interaction_patterns.emergency_header: Fixed insurance claim line (0808 100 8181 option 3) accessible at all times in Step 0 and expandable emergency banner.

wizard_step_flow.title: Are you safe?
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Immediate emergency support & key legal guidance
key_elements: Reassurance banner: Take a deep breath. We are here to help.
QBE 24 Hour Claim Line: 0808 100 8181 (Option 3) - Click to call button
Circle Insurance Services Ltd: 01260 292873 (Office hours) - Click to call button
QBE Policy Number: Y157953FLT0125A (Copy button included)
Critical Rules Checklist: 'Do not admit liability to anyone', 'If police request documents, state you will present them at nearest Police Station'
Big CTA: 'I am safe — Start Crash Pack'

wizard_step_flow.title: Your details & vehicle
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Driver information and vehicle status
key_elements: Driver info: Full Name, Home Address, Mobile Number, Date of Birth
UK Residency & License: Length of UK residency, Date passed driving test
Vehicle info: Registration, Make & Model, Current Mileage
Vehicle Use: Social vs Business use toggle
DVLA & Claims Toggles (Yes/No with instant follow-ups): Accidents in last 3 yrs, Convictions/Points, License disqualifications/suspensions, Medical conditions reported to DVLA
Damage description to your vehicle

wizard_step_flow.title: The accident
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: When and where it happened
key_elements: Accident Date & Time picker (defaults to now)
Location (Street / Junction / Postcode / Landmark)
Detailed accident description & road condition notes

wizard_step_flow.title: Photos & Sketch
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Visual evidence capture
key_elements: Camera tiles with mobile native camera support
Photo categories: Your vehicle damage, Scene / Road layout, Other vehicle(s) damage
Sketch capture: Option to upload photo of a hand-drawn sketch with notes

wizard_step_flow.title: Third parties
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Other drivers and vehicles involved
key_elements: Repeatable Third-Party Cards (Up to 3+ drivers)
Fields per third party: Name, Mobile, Address, Insurer Name & Policy #, Vehicle Reg, Vehicle Make/Model, Number of Passengers
Extent of vehicle damage & Any reported injuries

wizard_step_flow.title: Witnesses
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Bystander & passenger statements
key_elements: Repeatable Witness Cards: Witness Name, Phone Number, Email/Address, Witness Role (Passenger / Bystander)

wizard_step_flow.title: Police details
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: If police attended the scene
key_elements: Police attended? (Yes/No toggle)
Crime / Incident Reference Number
Officer Name & Officer Collar Number
Police Station / Constabulary Name

wizard_step_flow.title: Review & Submit
wizard_step_flow.subtitle: Final verification
key_elements: Summary view of all captured sections with quick 'Edit' shortcuts
Declaration confirmation checkbox
Prominent 'Submit Crash Pack Report' CTA with instant confirmation state and printable download option

printable_manager_report_spec.view_location: Operations > Staffing > Vehicles > Crash Packs tab
printable_manager_report_spec.page_format: A4 Printable Layout (HTML + Print CSS styling)
printable_manager_report_spec.header: Official Pulse Fitness Fleet Incident Report - Confidential
sections: Header Summary: Incident ID, Employee Name, Reg No, Date/Time, Policy Number Y157953FLT0125A
Section A: Driver & Vehicle Details (incl. DVLA & License declarations)
Section C: Photos & Diagram Grid (Rendered cleanly in 2-column or 3-column photo matrix)
Section D: Third Party & Witness Register
Section E: Police Attendance & Reference Details
Section F: Management Sign-off & Claims Log Status
printable_manager_report_spec.print_styles: Includes @media print rules: hides navigation bars, forces white background, clean black text, page-break-inside avoid on photo cards.

accessibility.aria_labels: All steps have aria-live progress updates and screen-reader readable step indicators.
accessibility.focus_management: Auto-scroll to top of card on step change; maintain focus ring on high-contrast cyan/emerald buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate the 'Crash Pack' card seamlessly inside Staff Portal > Vehicle tab without disrupting existing vehicle check or fleet features.
Ensure Step 0 shows all required emergency details verbatim: QBE 24 Hour Claim Line 0808 100 8181 (option 3), Circle Insurance Services Ltd 01260 292873, Policy Y157953FLT0125A.
Make phone numbers tap-to-call using tel: links with prominent green icon styling.
Build shock-friendly Yes/No toggles with large tap targets and zero cramped elements.
Support offline/draft saving between steps so state is never lost if signal drops at roadside.
In Operations > Staffing > Vehicles, add the 'Crash Packs' tab with table of submitted packs and printable A4 report modal.
Strictly follow data-testid attributes listed in guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Layered shadows (ambient + direct) for card depth.
Crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + shadows.
Hue consistency: tint borders/shadows/text toward bg hue.
Content must be visible with increased contrast on :hover/:active/:focus.
Meet contrast - prefer APCA over WCAG 2.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
